items.key_claim: 模型效果=模型+应用+算力，单向思维（仅重视模型）必须打破，在此过程中估值会大幅波动。

key_claim_i18n.en: Model effectiveness = model + app + compute; one-dimensional thinking (focusing only on models) must be broken, causing significant valuation volatility in the process.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 模型效果=模型+应用+算力，单向思维（仅重视模型）必须打破，在此过程中估值会大幅波动。

items.risk: 市场可能因过度聚焦单一因素（如模型）而对行业估值产生非理性波动，影响半导体等细分赛道。

risk_i18n.en: Market may experience irrational valuation volatility due to over-focus on a single factor (e.g., models), impacting segments like semiconductors.
risk_i18n.zh: 市场可能因过度聚焦单一因素（如模型）而对行业估值产生非理性波动，影响半导体等细分赛道。

items.summary: 作者一直强调模型效果=模型+应用+算力，批评单向思维（仅模型万能）。认为打破这一思维过程中，估值（而非盈利）会大幅波动，这在半导体等高投入领域尤为显著。

summary_i18n.en: The author has been emphasizing that model effectiveness = model + app + compute, criticizing one-dimensional thinking (model as a cure-all). Breaking this mindset will cause valuation (not earnings) to fluctuate significantly, especially in high-investment sectors like semiconductors.
summary_i18n.zh: 作者一直强调模型效果=模型+应用+算力，批评单向思维（仅模型万能）。认为打破这一思维过程中，估值（而非盈利）会大幅波动，这在半导体等高投入领域尤为显著。

items.key_claim: AI只会取代代码农而非软件工程师，软件公司因使用尖端模型和更多工具获益，AI将导致智力集中在少数人手中，权力进一步集中。

key_claim_i18n.en: AI will only replace coders, not software engineers; software companies benefit from using cutting-edge models and more tools, leading to intelligence concentrated in a few hands and further power consolidation.
key_claim_i18n.zh: AI只会取代代码农而非软件工程师，软件公司因使用尖端模型和更多工具获益，AI将导致智力集中在少数人手中，权力进一步集中。

items.risk: 对AI取代范围预测可能过于极端，实际中软件工程师岗位也可能被自动化部分替代；权力集中假设忽略监管和市场竞争的制衡作用。

risk_i18n.en: The prediction of AI replacement scope may be too extreme; in practice, software engineering roles may also be partially automated; power concentration assumption ignores regulatory and market competition checks.
risk_i18n.zh: 对AI取代范围预测可能过于极端，实际中软件工程师岗位也可能被自动化部分替代；权力集中假设忽略监管和市场竞争的制衡作用。

items.summary: 通过援引Jensen观点，指出AI将淘汰代码农，而软件工程师因使用更先进模型和工具获利；AI还会催生大量程序员，但只有软件公司是“上等人”；最终智力集中于少数人，权力进一步集中，社会不平等加剧。

summary_i18n.en: Herman Jin, citing Jensen's view, states that AI will eliminate coders while software engineers benefit from using more advanced models and tools; AI will also spawn many programmers, but only software companies are the 'first-class citizens'; ultimately, intelligence concentrates in a few hands, power consolidates further, and social inequality worsens.
summary_i18n.zh: 通过援引Jensen观点，指出AI将淘汰代码农，而软件工程师因使用更先进模型和工具获利；AI还会催生大量程序员，但只有软件公司是“上等人”；最终智力集中于少数人，权力进一步集中，社会不平等加剧。

items.risk: Meta的云端AI战略混乱，在CPU上已合作多个伙伴，AI加速器方面存在不确定性；联发科是否最终落地尚需时间验证。

risk_i18n.en: Meta's cloud AI strategy appears chaotic, with multiple CPU partners, and AI accelerator cooperation is uncertain; MediaTek's final deal remains unconfirmed.
risk_i18n.zh: Meta的云端AI战略混乱，在CPU上已合作多个伙伴，AI加速器方面存在不确定性；联发科是否最终落地尚需时间验证。

items.summary: 联发科继Google之后，据供应链消息已锁定Meta作为第二个CSP大客户，ASIC合作围绕AI加速器芯片；Meta虽然与博通等也有合作，但联发科同时持有Google的TPU订单（Zebrafish、Humufish及v9 Triggerfish），从2026底至2029年可稳定获得TPU量产收入，相比高通2029年150亿美元云端AI目标，联发科手握多个TPU订单达到100亿美元级别只是时间问题。Meta在CPU上多路合作，但AI加速器合作仍缺明确消息，若联发科拿下Meta将显著助力其ASIC业务。@jukan05 通过转载Digitimes文章表达对MTK ASIC业务前景的乐观。

summary_i18n.en: MediaTek has reportedly secured Meta as its second CSP customer for AI accelerator ASICs, according to supply chain sources, alongside Google's TPU orders (Zebrafish, Humufish, v9 Triggerfish). With stable TPU production revenue from late 2026 to 2029, MediaTek reaching $10B revenue from ASICs is only a matter of time, versus Qualcomm's $15B target in 2029. Meta, while working with multiple CPU partners (Arm, Qualcomm), still lacks a clear AI accelerator partner; if MediaTek lands Meta, it would significantly boost its ASIC business. @jukan05 expresses optimism about MediaTek's ASIC prospects via this Digitimes article.

risk_i18n.en: Meta's cloud AI strategy appears chaotic, with multiple CPU partners, and AI accelerator cooperation is uncertain; MediaTek's final deal remains unconfirmed.
risk_i18n.zh: Meta的云端AI战略混乱，在CPU上已合作多个伙伴，AI加速器方面存在不确定性；联发科是否最终落地尚需时间验证。

items.summary: 联发科继Google之后，据供应链消息已锁定Meta作为第二个CSP大客户，ASIC合作围绕AI加速器芯片；Meta虽然与博通等也有合作，但联发科同时持有Google的TPU订单（Zebrafish、Humufish及v9 Triggerfish），从2026底至2029年可稳定获得TPU量产收入，相比高通2029年150亿美元云端AI目标，联发科手握多个TPU订单达到100亿美元级别只是时间问题。Meta在CPU上多路合作，但AI加速器合作仍缺明确消息，若联发科拿下Meta将显著助力其ASIC业务。

summary_i18n.en: MediaTek has reportedly secured Meta as its second CSP customer for AI accelerator ASICs, according to supply chain sources, alongside Google's TPU orders (Zebrafish, Humufish, v9 Triggerfish). With stable TPU production revenue from late 2026 to 2029, MediaTek reaching $10B revenue from ASICs is only a matter of time, versus Qualcomm's $15B target in 2029. Meta, while working with multiple CPU partners (Arm, Qualcomm), still lacks a clear AI accelerator partner; if MediaTek lands Meta, it would significantly boost its ASIC business.

key_claim_i18n.en: Huawei will launch its Ascend AI accelerator chips and Atlas 950 SuperPoD computing system in Korea for the first time in Q4 2026, claiming 2.87x the inference performance of NVIDIA's H20 at roughly one-quarter the price, and plans a 'de-NVIDIA' marketing campaign.

items.risk: 韩国市场对中国技术和产品的敏感性，以及散热导致的功耗问题可能成为华为进入韩国AI市场的障碍。

risk_i18n.en: Domestic sensitivity in Korea towards Chinese technology and products, along with power consumption issues from heat dissipation, could pose obstacles to Huawei's entry into the Korean AI market.

items.summary: 华为韩国将在2026年Q4推出Ascend 950DT（训练）和950PR（推理）NPU芯片及Atlas 950 SuperPoD系统（最多容纳8192颗芯片），宣称在推理方面性能是NVIDIA H20的2.87倍，价格约四分之一。华为已完成与SK Shieldus等两家分销商的合作，并以DeepSeek v4等客户验证为信心，提高与CUDA兼容性，计划通过“去NVIDIA”营销吸引韩国市场，但韩国对中国技术的敏感性和散热功耗问题可能形成阻力。

summary_i18n.en: Huawei Korea plans to launch Ascend 950DT (training) and 950PR (inference) NPU chips plus the Atlas 950 SuperPoD system (up to 8,192 chips) in Q4 2026, claiming 2.87x inference performance over NVIDIA's H20 at one-quarter the price. Huawei has secured two distributors, including SK Shieldus, and cites customer validation from DeepSeek v4, improved CUDA compatibility, and a 'de-NVIDIA' marketing strategy to target the Korean market, though local sensitivity to Chinese technology and power/heat issues pose risks.

items.summary: KOSPI处于上升通道下轨支撑位，近期弱势主因是资金面流出：中国基金卖出以参与CXMT IPO、其他外资卖出以购买美国上市的SK Hynix ADR、韩国养老基金持续卖出再平衡。该通道是重要防线，保持关注。

summary_i18n.en: AXE signed a three-year, US$1.5 million quantum compute agreement with IONQ, gaining cloud access to IONQ's 36-qubit Forte processor to refine its quantum machine learning fraud detection models. The companies will also conduct a feasibility study for deploying a physical IONQ quantum computer in an Australian data center, targeting Australia's projected $6 billion domestic quantum market by 2030, serving defense, government, and banking clients. items.summary: Physical AI 需要边缘 AI，而边缘 AI 依赖塔上 AI（AI-RAN），塔上 AI 又需要无线电台作为硬件。NVIDIA 正将 GPU 嵌入基站，AMPG 的无线电已在其全球首个开源 Massive MIMO AI-RAN 演示中验证。AMPG 是美国唯一经过验证的自主电台，在物理 AI 部署初期市值不到10亿美元，具备早期投资价值。 重点标的: $AMPG., $CCXI., $AVAV.

summary_i18n.en: Physical AI requires Edge AI, which depends on AI on the tower (AI-RAN), and that requires a radio as hardware. NVIDIA is embedding GPUs into base stations, and AMPG's radio has been validated in the world's first open-source Massive MIMO AI-RAN demo. AMPG is the only US-validated domestic radio, sub-$1B market cap at the early stage of Physical AI deployment, offering early-investment value. Key tickers: $AMPG., $CCXI., $AVAV.

items.key_claim: Meta没有削减资本开支，反而因超大规模云厂商算力约束被迫签下超过480亿美元的Neocloud长期合约，未来capex只会向上。 重点标的: $META, $GOOGL, $CRWV, $NBIS.

key_claim_i18n.en: Meta is not cutting capex; instead, due to hyperscaler compute constraints, it was forced to sign over $48B in long-term Neocloud contracts, and capex will only go higher. Key tickers: $META, $GOOGL, $CRWV, $NBIS.
key_claim_i18n.zh: Meta没有削减资本开支，反而因超大规模云厂商算力约束被迫签下超过480亿美元的Neocloud长期合约，未来capex只会向上。 重点标的: $META, $GOOGL, $CRWV, $NBIS.

items.risk: 若AI需求降温或Neocloud产能过剩，Meta可能面临毁约风险；且竞争加剧可能压低利润率。

risk_i18n.en: If AI demand cools or Neocloud capacity becomes oversupplied, Meta could face contract breach risks; intensifying competition may also compress margins.
risk_i18n.zh: 若AI需求降温或Neocloud产能过剩，Meta可能面临毁约风险；且竞争加剧可能压低利润率。

items.summary: 推文反驳了Meta因过度建设而削减资本开支的说法。实际是谷歌等超大规模云厂商算力紧缺，导致Meta内部项目受限制，从而被迫与Neocloud（如CRWV、NBIS）签订超过480亿美元的take-or-pay长期合约。如果存在富余产能，Meta才可能出售，但目前看产能紧张，未来资本开支大概率继续上调。 重点标的: $META, $GOOGL, $CRWV, $NBIS.

summary_i18n.en: The tweet refutes the claim that Meta is cutting capex due to overbuilding. In reality, hyperscalers like Google were so compute-constrained that they cut allocations to Meta, forcing Meta to sign over $48B in take-or-pay long-term contracts with Neoclouds like CRWV and NBIS. Meta would only sell excess capacity if any exists, but currently capacity is tight, and future capex is likely to rise. Key tickers: $META, $GOOGL, $CRWV, $NBIS.
summary_i18n.zh: 推文反驳了Meta因过度建设而削减资本开支的说法。实际是谷歌等超大规模云厂商算力紧缺，导致Meta内部项目受限制，从而被迫与Neocloud（如CRWV、NBIS）签订超过480亿美元的take-or-pay长期合约。如果存在富余产能，Meta才可能出售，但目前看产能紧张，未来资本开支大概率继续上调。 重点标的: $META, $GOOGL, $CRWV, $NBIS.

items.summary: $AMKR 盘前下跌是上车机会。自 3 月份介绍以来，$AMPG 涨近 4 倍，$AMKR 翻倍。AMKR 与 TSMC 签订 10 年协议，TSMC 采购先进封装和测试服务，两家都在 Arizona 建厂，补齐美国芯片产业链闭环（TSMC fab + Amkor OSAT）。AMKR 锁定全球最大晶圆代工作为锚点客户，降低美国产能扩张需求侧风险，成为美国先进封装默认合作方。订单预计 2027-2028 年体现，看空者担忧毛利不高和 Arizona CAPEX 巨大，但协议已 de-risk CAPEX，ROI 合理。

summary_i18n.en: $AMKR pre-market decline is a buying opportunity. Since the introduction in March, $AMPG has risen nearly 4x, and $AMKR has doubled. AMKR signed a 10-year agreement with TSMC for advanced packaging and testing services; both are building plants in Arizona, completing the US chip supply chain (TSMC fab + Amkor OSAT). AMKR locks in the world's largest foundry as an anchor customer, reducing demand-side risk for US capacity expansion, becoming the default US advanced packaging partner. Orders are expected to materialize in 2027-2028. Bears worry about low margins and high Arizona CAPEX, but the agreement de-risks CAPEX and the ROI is reasonable.

Personally long-term investing, but suggest waiting for OEMs (e.g., Agility or Figure) to emerge as de facto leaders before upstream supply chain (e.g., Harmonic Drive, Leaderdrive) sees clear volume/price inflection. Currently Siemens/$TSLA only running POC tests in few factories, UK 'Humanoid' generations behind, dexterous hand development slow, limiting commercial TAM expansion. Key tickers: $AMZN, $MELI, $NVDA

summary_i18n.en: $TRT's market cap has crossed and held around $100-150M, a size threshold that allows Wall Street funds and analysts to take notice. The company has received its first-ever analyst coverage from Zacks. Higher market cap and liquidity attract more coverage and institutional positioning, potentially leading to index inclusion—forming a 'discovery flywheel.' Business fundamentals have already improved; market attention is now catching up.

key_claim_i18n.en: Samsung embeds quantum computing into photolithography simulation, potentially boosting chip density and yield while shortening R&D cycles.

items.risk: 量子计算技术尚处早期，POC结果存在不确定性；商业化路径未明确，对三星电子收入的实质贡献仍需时日。

risk_i18n.en: Quantum computing is still early-stage; POC results are uncertain; commercialization path is not defined, so material revenue contribution to Samsung Electronics will take time.
risk_i18n.zh: 量子计算技术尚处早期，POC结果存在不确定性；商业化路径未明确，对三星电子收入的实质贡献仍需时日。

items.summary: 三星SDS正开发将量子计算机用于光刻仿真的算法，目标加快半导体图案绘制、降低成本和提升精度。POC计划在2026年下半年开展，成功后技术将共享给三星电子（005930），有望改善芯片密度与良率。三星电子自身半导体研究所已长期投入制程仿真，此次量子计算嵌入是向下一代计算资源的战略性布局。

summary_i18n.en: Samsung SDS is developing algorithms that use quantum computers to simulate photolithography, aiming to accelerate pattern drawing, reduce costs, and improve precision. A POC is planned for the second half of 2026; upon success, the technology will be shared with Samsung Electronics (005930), potentially enhancing chip density and yield. Samsung Electronics' semiconductor research institute has long invested in process simulation, and this quantum integration marks a strategic move toward next-generation computing resources.

items.summary: IREN赞助金州勇士队并非表面上的营销噱头，而是NVDA战略的一部分。NVDA的三大客户（Amazon、Google、Microsoft）都在自研芯片，试图摆脱对NVDA的依赖，因此NVDA必须扶持CoreWeave、Nebius、IREN等忠实的新云。NVDA董事会成员Mark Stevens同时在勇士队有影响力，IREN通过赞助勇士队可以在湾区建立本地品牌，吸引开发者参加活动并进入CUDA生态。CUDA的锁定效应使早期开发者几乎不会切换生态系统。此前@chinoalemano指出，IREN已获得NVDA的Exemplar Cloud认证、3.4B美元云合同、NVDA高达2.1B美元的期权投资，以及与Dell的1.6B美元Blackwell系统订单，正沿着AWS的路径被三方共同打造。 重点标的: $IREN, $NVDA.

summary_i18n.en: IREN's sponsorship of the Golden State Warriors is not a superficial marketing stunt but part of NVDA's strategic plan. NVDA's top three customers (Amazon, Google, Microsoft) are all developing their own chips to reduce dependence on NVDA, so NVDA must support loyal neoclouds like CoreWeave, Nebius, and IREN. NVDA board member Mark Stevens also has influence with the Warriors; by sponsoring the team, IREN can build a local Bay Area brand and attract developers to events and the CUDA ecosystem. CUDA's lock-in effect makes early developers rarely switch ecosystems. @chinoalemano previously noted that IREN has obtained NVDA's Exemplar Cloud certification, a $3.4B cloud contract, a potential $2.1B option investment from NVDA, and a $1.6B order with Dell for Blackwell systems, being built along the path of AWS by three parties. Key tickers: $IREN, $NVDA.

items.summary: 韩国主要半导体基板制造商（面向三星电子和SK海力士）正在谈判下半年交货价格，上游金、铜等原材料成本仍处高位，但下游半导体厂商希望将Q1已上调3-4%的价格回吐。若价格回落到年初水平，基板制造商面临成本高+价格降的双重压力，可能导致资本支出和下一代技术开发受限。行业组织KPCA呼吁扩大成本联动体系，并建立供应链合作机制，以维持基板环节的竞争力和可持续性。

summary_i18n.en: Major Korean semiconductor substrate manufacturers (supplying Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix) are negotiating H2 delivery prices. Raw material costs for gold and copper remain high, but downstream chipmakers want to reverse the 3-4% price increase implemented in Q1. If prices fall back to early-year levels, substrate makers face a double burden of high costs and lower prices, which could limit capital expenditure and next-gen technology development. The industry association KPCA calls for expanding the cost pass-through system and establishing a supply chain cooperation mechanism to sustain substrate sector competitiveness.

items.key_claim: Sivers成功以57 SEK向机构投资者超额完成7亿瑞典克朗的upside轮融资，均价接近市价，为股价提供底部支撑，并标志着其从研发到量产（HVM）的拐点。 重点标的: $SIVE

key_claim_i18n.en: Sivers successfully completed an upsized SEK 700M upside round for institutional investors at SEK 57, near the current market price, providing a floor for the stock and marking its inflection point from R&D to high-volume manufacturing (HVM). Key tickers: $SIVE
key_claim_i18n.zh: Sivers成功以57 SEK向机构投资者超额完成7亿瑞典克朗的upside轮融资，均价接近市价，为股价提供底部支撑，并标志着其从研发到量产（HVM）的拐点。 重点标的: $SIVE

items.risk: 融资成本接近市价，若大盘情绪转弱或InP激光器需求不及预期，57 SEK支撑可能被跌破；产能扩张的执行风险。

risk_i18n.en: The raise price is near market; if macro sentiment sours or InP laser demand disappoints, the SEK 57 floor could break; execution risk in capacity expansion remains.

items.summary: Sivers以57 SEK每股完成7亿瑞典克朗（约7300万美元）的upside融资，获数倍超额认购，资金专门用于扩产InP激光器及光放大器，采用fab-light模式。此次融资验证了机构投资者对当前股价的强劲需求，设定底部支撑，并加速公司向大规模量产的转变。 重点标的: $SIVE

summary_i18n.en: Sivers completed an upsized SEK 700M (approx. $73M) upside round at SEK 57 per share, multiple times oversubscribed, specifically for expanding InP laser and optical amplifier manufacturing capacity using a fab-light model. The raise validates strong institutional demand at current prices, sets a floor, and accelerates the transition to HVM. Key tickers: $SIVE
summary_i18n.zh: Sivers以57 SEK每股完成7亿瑞典克朗（约7300万美元）的upside融资，获数倍超额认购，资金专门用于扩产InP激光器及光放大器，采用fab-light模式。此次融资验证了机构投资者对当前股价的强劲需求，设定底部支撑，并加速公司向大规模量产的转变。 重点标的: $SIVE

items.key_claim: 买入$ON/$MXL和卖出$GLW的策略基于光学股可能受益于行业尾风，且21日均线是弱势股较差入市点。

key_claim_i18n.en: The strategy of buying $ON/$MXL and selling $GLW is based on optical stocks potentially benefiting from industry tailwinds, and the 21-day moving average being a poor entry for weaker names.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 买入$ON/$MXL和卖出$GLW的策略基于光学股可能受益于行业尾风，且21日均线是弱势股较差入市点。

items.risk: 光学股如果整体行业景气度下行，尾风反转可能导致亏损；均线策略依赖技术面，可能失效。

risk_i18n.en: If the overall optical industry cycle turns down, the tailwind may reverse causing losses; the moving average strategy is technically dependent and may fail.
risk_i18n.zh: 光学股如果整体行业景气度下行，尾风反转可能导致亏损；均线策略依赖技术面，可能失效。

items.summary: 在回复中表示，今日开盘买入$ON/$MXL（光学/功率半导体）并在269价位卖出$GLW。他认为光学股属于弱势名称（weak names），但参考21日均线入市（in reply to tweet: '21ma on weaker names.. opticals'），同时指出上周$ON的利空并购（dumb acquisition）后功率半导体仍便利买入（easy buy），存在行业尾风作为下行保护。该操作体现了对光学/半导体标的的短期看涨及对$GLW的止盈。

summary_i18n.en: @labubu_trader in a reply states that today at the open they bought $ON/$MXL (optical/power semiconductor) and sold $GLW at 269. They consider opticals as weak names but entered using the 21-day moving average (in reply to tweet: '21ma on weaker names.. opticals'), while noting that after last week's dumb acquisition by $ON, power semis were still an easy buy with industry tailwinds providing downside protection. This trade reflects a short-term bullish view on optical/semiconductor names and profit-taking on $GLW.
summary_i18n.zh: 在回复中表示，今日开盘买入$ON/$MXL（光学/功率半导体）并在269价位卖出$GLW。他认为光学股属于弱势名称（weak names），但参考21日均线入市（in reply to tweet: '21ma on weaker names.. opticals'），同时指出上周$ON的利空并购（dumb acquisition）后功率半导体仍便利买入（easy buy），存在行业尾风作为下行保护。该操作体现了对光学/半导体标的的短期看涨及对$GLW的止盈。

summary_i18n.en: chinoalemano is deeply bullish on $IREN with four core arguments: First, dilution is a necessary cost for early infrastructure capital; as long as revenue growth (to $3.7B ARR) outpaces equity dilution, shareholder value is preserved. Second, brand marketing spending is misunderstood; it's actually part of NVIDIA's ecosystem strategy to lock in long-term compute demand by capturing founders early, akin to AWS Activate. Third, IREN's communication is actually very clear, but the market habitually distorts it—Dan Roberts explicitly stated that with NVIDIA's referrals, a sales team is unnecessary, which the market twisted. Fourth, the bearish narrative ignores the strong probability of IREN transforming from a miner into an AI infrastructure giant. The current market distrust and negative noise are exactly the entry price for owning early-stage growth infrastructure.

items.summary: IREN 在过去一年积累了至少13个未被市场定价的催化剂，包括英伟达 Exemplar Cloud 认证、Sweetwater 1.4GW 按时通电、功率从2.9GW跃升至5.8GW（超越CRWV与NBIS成为最大Neocloud）、宣布1.6GW俄克拉荷马与800MW澳大利亚数据中心、ARR目标从34亿提升至44亿美元、收购Mirantis并扩展欧洲490MW、签署34亿美元英伟达软件合约（Neocloud与Mag7唯一软件交易）、英伟达有权投资至多21亿美元、Sweetwater被选为DSX AI工厂蓝图、全球管道持续披露。IREN与英伟达、戴尔构成完整超大规模云三层架构：硅片（英伟达）、系统（戴尔）、电力与运营（IREN）。英伟达为对抗自研芯片客户趋势，必须让IREN成长。市场仍将IREN视为前比特币矿工，并未计入这些催化剂。 重点标的: $IREN, $NVDA, $DELL

summary_i18n.en: IREN has accumulated at least 13 catalysts over the past year that the market has not priced in, including NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud certification, Sweetwater 1.4GW energized on time, power capacity jumping from 2.9GW to 5.8GW (surpassing CRWV and NBIS to become the largest neocloud), announcing a 1.6GW Oklahoma data center and an 800MW Australia data center, raising ARR target from $3.4B to $4.4B, acquiring Mirantis and expanding in Europe by 490MW, signing a $3.4B software deal with NVIDIA (the only neocloud-Mag7 software deal), NVIDIA having the option to invest up to $2.1B, Sweetwater selected as the flagship blueprint for NVIDIA's DSX AI factory, and a continuously disclosed global pipeline. IREN, NVIDIA, and Dell form a complete three-layer hyperscaler architecture: silicon (NVIDIA), systems (Dell), and power & operations (IREN). To counter the trend of customers building their own chips, NVIDIA must make IREN succeed. The market still prices IREN as a former Bitcoin miner and has not reflected these catalysts. Key tickers: $IREN, $NVDA, $DELL

items.key_claim: AI数据中心的互联正从铜缆大规模转向光纤，光模块厂商$AAOI将结构性受益。

key_claim_i18n.en: AI data center interconnects are shifting massively from copper to fiber, structurally benefiting optical transceiver maker $AAOI.
key_claim_i18n.zh: AI数据中心的互联正从铜缆大规模转向光纤，光模块厂商$AAOI将结构性受益。

items.risk: 如果铜缆技术取得突破（如新材料或信号补偿）延缓替代速度，或光纤供应过剩压降单价，可能削弱AAOI的增速预期。

risk_i18n.en: If copper technology breakthrough (e.g., new materials or signal compensation) slows the substitution pace, or if fiber oversupply depresses unit prices, AAOI's growth expectations may be dampened.
risk_i18n.zh: 如果铜缆技术取得突破（如新材料或信号补偿）延缓替代速度，或光纤供应过剩压降单价，可能削弱AAOI的增速预期。

items.summary: 随着AI集群GPU间互联速度从400G往3.2T提升，铜缆的有效传输距离从数米缩短到不足1米，而光纤可支持数百米至数公里。AI数据中心动辄数万GPU，大部分跨机柜、跨行、跨楼宇的链路只能靠光纤，每代速率翻倍都会进一步挤压铜缆的生存空间，形成对光模块厂商$AAOI的结构性利好。

summary_i18n.en: As AI cluster GPU interconnect speeds scale from 400G to 3.2T, copper's effective reach shrinks from meters to under 1 meter, while fiber supports hundreds of meters to kilometers. With tens of thousands of GPUs in a single AI data center, most cross-rack, cross-row, and cross-building links must use optics. Each speed doubling further erodes copper's viability, creating a structural tailwind for optical transceiver maker $AAOI.

items.summary: Harmonic Drive Systems（东京Prime上市，股票代码6324）是全球谐波减速器（应变波齿轮）的发明者和高端市场主导者，其产品几乎出现在所有人形机器人演示（Figure、Optimus、宇树）的关键关节中。该公司拥有40年以上的技术积累，尤其柔轮(flexspline)的疲劳寿命是核心壁垒，且通过航空航天、半导体、医疗领域的认证锁定带来极高的切换成本。最新财报显示周期回升：到2026年3月年度净销售额增长7%至596亿日元，四季度EPS从-0.40日元升至8.86日元，预计2027财年销售额增长14.2%至680亿日元，经营利润增长141%至62亿日元。更关键的是，人形机器人订单已初步落地：单季约13亿日元，全年约25亿日元，管理层预期下一财年翻倍或三倍，潜在人形客户超过15家。资产负债表强劲（72%权益比率、净现金），有资金支持美国工厂扩张33%而不稀释股东。主要风险：在中国市场份额从70%降至约20%，国产龙头Leaderdrive和来福以40-60%价格优势抢市场；特斯拉Optimus可能多源采购，Harmonic Drive并非唯一供应商。综合来看，这是最纯正的人形机器人执行器持仓标的。

summary_i18n.en: Harmonic Drive Systems (listed on Tokyo Prime, ticker 6324) is the inventor and dominant supplier of high-end harmonic drives (strain-wave gears), with its products appearing in the critical joints of virtually all humanoid robot demos (Figure, Optimus, Unitree). The company benefits from over 40 years of accumulated knowledge, especially in flexspline fatigue life, and extremely high switching costs due to certification lock-in in aerospace, semiconductor, and medical applications. Latest earnings show a cyclical recovery: net sales up 7% to ¥59.6B, EPS swinging from -¥0.40 to ¥8.86 in Q4; FY2027 guidance implies sales up 14.2% to ¥68.0B and operating profit up 141% to ¥6.2B. Critically, humanoid orders are inflecting: ¥1.3B in a single quarter, ~¥2.5B guided for FY2026, with management expecting a 2-3x increase next year and 15+ potential humanoid customers. The balance sheet is fortress-like (72% equity ratio, net cash), allowing 33% US plant expansion without dilution. Key risks: market share in China has fallen from ~70% to ~20%, with domestic champions Leaderdrive and Laifual undercutting by 40-60%; Tesla's Optimus may multi-source, so Harmonic Drive is not the sole chokepoint. Overall, it offers the cleanest listed exposure to humanoid actuators.

items.summary: $AMPG 是仅有的美国 64T64R Massive MIMO O-RAN 无线电、OTIC 认证、毛利率从 33% 提升至 48%、营收同比增长 48.6%、无债务、现金约 1800 万美元。其低噪声放大器用于反无人机雷达（国防），ULNA 原型用于 LEO 星座（太空），低温放大器用于超导量子计算机（量子），AI-RAN 与 NVIDIA Aerial 合作实现世界首例开源演示。Amazon 作为唯一自建 LEO 网络的财富 50 强公司出现在 AMPG 客户墙。在华为/中兴被禁和 Buy American 政策下，美国制造是关键优势。 重点标的: $NVDA, $AMZN., $AMPG.

summary_i18n.en: $AMPG is the only U.S. company with a 64T64R Massive MIMO O-RAN radio, OTIC-certified, with gross margins improving from 33% to 48%, revenue up 48.6% year-over-year, debt-free, and about $18M cash. Its low-noise amplifiers are used in counter-drone radars (defense), ULNA prototypes for LEO constellations (space), cryogenic amplifiers for superconducting quantum computers (quantum), and its AI-RAN demo with NVIDIA Aerial was the world's first open-source demonstration. Amazon, the only Fortune 50 building its own LEO network, appears on AMPG's customer wall. With Huawei/ZTE banned and Buy American rules, U.S. manufacturing is a key advantage. Key tickers: $NVDA, $AMZN., $AMPG.

items.summary: 反无人机主题再次升温，TSA确认世界杯以来已有超过300架无人机被扣押，所有78场比赛均配有反无人机保护。$AMPG的低噪声放大器（LNA）是每套反无人机系统接收链中的关键元件，其客户包括洛克希德、诺斯罗普、L3Harris等。2027财年美国国防预算请求超700亿美元用于无人机与反无人机，陆军反无人机预算接近10亿美元。AMPG还涉足太空、量子计算和AI-RAN——其64T64R Massive MIMO无线电已用于NVIDIA Aerial软件的首个开源AI-RAN演示。AMPG市值当前仍低于10亿美元。非投资建议，作者长期持有$AMPG。 重点标的: $DPRO, $ONDS, $MRLN., $AMPG.

summary_i18n.en: The counter-drone theme is heating up again, with TSA confirming over 300 drones seized near World Cup venues and all 78 matches protected by counter-drone systems. $AMPG's low-noise amplifiers (LNAs) are a critical component in every C-UAS receive chain, with customers including Lockheed, Northrop, L3Harris, and NASA. FY2027 US defense budget requests over $70B for drones and counter-UAS, with Army C-UAS spending nearly $1B. AMPG also spans space, quantum computing, and AI-RAN—its 64T64R Massive MIMO radio was used in the world's first open-source AI-RAN demo on NVIDIA Aerial. Market cap remains under $1B. Not financial advice; author is long $AMPG. Key tickers: $DPRO, $ONDS, $MRLN.

items.summary: $SIVE 启动约 6100 万美元（6亿瑞典克朗）融资，用于扩张 InP 激光器和光放大器产能。Sivers 采用 fab-lite 模式，此次融资很可能指向为其 CW DFB 激光器在 Jabil 及其他合作伙伴处争取代工厂资源分配和规模化，也可能扩展到已宣布的 WIN 合作伙伴关系之外。如果投资来自长期机构且无大幅折价（低于 30 天 VWAP），则非常看涨；否则需警惕套利或短期资本。当前是引入战略投资者（如 $GFS）和增加美国机构支持的理想时机，尤其考虑到 5600 万美元对于想获取光子学敞口的单一美国机构来说数额较小（参考 Poet 的 4 亿美元注册直接发行），整体上这是量产化的积极信号。

summary_i18n.en: $SIVE is raising approximately $61 million (600 million SEK) to expand manufacturing capacity for InP lasers and optical amplifiers. Sivers operates a fab-lite model, so this likely points to foundry allocation and scaling for its CW DFB laser ramp across Jabil and other partners, potentially extending beyond the announced WIN partnership. It is very bullish if composed of long-only institutions with no heavy discount (below 30-day VWAP); otherwise, arbitrage or short-term investor risks arise. This is an ideal time to bring strategic investors like $GFS onto the cap table and increase US institutional support, especially given $56 million is a small check for a single US institution seeking photonics exposure (e.g., look at Poet's $400 million registered direct offering sentiment). Overall, this is a very positive signal for mass production.

items.summary: NVIDIA CEO黄仁勋（Jensen）厌恶超大规模云厂商垄断AI计算，因此通过资助新兴AI实验室和NeoCloud（如Crusoe、CoreWeave）来创造多极世界，这是一项针对定制芯片（如Google TPU、Amazon Trainium）的长期博弈。这些投入像抛饵入水，让最强者生存；尽管多数会失败，但少数成功者将立即带来数亿美元ARR。

summary_i18n.en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang hates hyperscalers monopolizing AI compute, so he funds emerging AI labs and NeoClouds (e.g., Crusoe, CoreWeave) to create a multipolar world—a long-term play against custom chips like Google TPU and Amazon Trainium. These investments are like bait in the water, letting the strongest survive; most will fail, but a few successful ones will generate hundreds of millions in ARR out of the gate.

summary_i18n.en: PENG has multiple catalysts ahead of its July 7 earnings: becoming an NVIDIA AI Factory Specialized Partner (validating its rare global execution capability), delivering Korea's Haein sovereign AI cluster in 2 months (1,000+ B200 Blackwell GPUs), launching the industry's first CXL KV Cache Server with a Tier 1 financial institution as its first customer, winning Dell's Americas AI Partner of the Year, reaffirming full-year guidance at the high end ($1.67B revenue, $2.30 EPS), and Stifel raising its price target from $24 to $66 (+175%). items.key_claim: CUDA生态入口决定云厂商估值，绑定创业公司早期算力与工具链可产生高迁移成本。

key_claim_i18n.zh: CUDA生态入口决定云厂商估值，绑定创业公司早期算力与工具链可产生高迁移成本。

items.risk: 技术路线若转向非CUDA架构（如AMD、华为），绑定效应可能减弱。

risk_i18n.en: If the technology roadmap shifts to non-CUDA architectures (e.g., AMD, Huawei), the lock-in effect may weaken.
risk_i18n.zh: 技术路线若转向非CUDA架构（如AMD、华为），绑定效应可能减弱。

items.summary: 核心逻辑是CUDA生态入口而非单一云厂商估值。能将创业公司早期算力、工具链和部署绑定的厂商，后迁移成本将极高，从而在2027年前确立护城河。

summary_i18n.en: The core logic is the CUDA ecosystem entry point, not a single cloud vendor's valuation. Vendors that can bind startups' early compute, toolchain, and deployment will face extremely high switching costs, building a moat by 2027.
summary_i18n.zh: 核心逻辑是CUDA生态入口而非单一云厂商估值。能将创业公司早期算力、工具链和部署绑定的厂商，后迁移成本将极高，从而在2027年前确立护城河。

key_claim_i18n.zh: 市场低估的是电力与动能容量，而非硅片或机架；率先获取电网互联的企业将胜出。

items.risk: 电网审批周期长于预期，或出现区域性电力瓶颈。

risk_i18n.zh: 电网审批周期长于预期，或出现区域性电力瓶颈。

items.summary: 市场低估的是IREN的核心资产——电力与动能容量。硅片和机架可花钱买到，但兆瓦数和电网互联在2027年前几乎无法新增。AWS的竞争对手不是拥有最佳芯片的厂商，而是率先锁定电网互联的企业。

summary_i18n.en: The market underprices IREN's core assets: power and energized capacity. Silicon and racks can be bought with money, but megawatts and grid interconnection are nearly non-scalable before 2027. AWS's competitor is not the company with the best chips, but the one that locks in grid interconnection first.
summary_i18n.zh: 市场低估的是IREN的核心资产——电力与动能容量。硅片和机架可花钱买到，但兆瓦数和电网互联在2027年前几乎无法新增。AWS的竞争对手不是拥有最佳芯片的厂商，而是率先锁定电网互联的企业。

items.key_claim: 三星电子为HBM4E/HBM5申请的顶部虚拟芯片专利，通过阶梯曲面结构改善分层、翘曲和散热，有望显著提升高堆叠HBM良率和长期可靠性。

key_claim_i18n.en: Samsung Electronics' patent for the top dummy die in HBM4E/HBM5, with a stepped curved structure, improves delamination, warpage, and heat dissipation, potentially boosting yield and long-term reliability for high-stack HBM.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 三星电子为HBM4E/HBM5申请的顶部虚拟芯片专利，通过阶梯曲面结构改善分层、翘曲和散热，有望显著提升高堆叠HBM良率和长期可靠性。

items.risk: 专利落地到量产尚需时间，HBM4E/HBM5技术路线存在不确定性；若竞争对手（如SK海力士）同步推出更优方案，市场份额扩张可能不及预期。

items.summary: 三星电子已提交一项新专利，用于解决HBM4E及HBM5高堆叠（16层及以上）导致的分层、翘曲和良率下降问题。专利通过将顶部虚拟芯片设计为三级阶梯加曲面结构，并采用深槽锯切工艺，改善机械强度和散热，同时减少切割碎屑污染。此前12层HBM良率较8层下降10-20个百分点，16层以上良率可降至40-60%区间；该专利被视为提升三星在高带宽内存市场份额的关键技术，并可与混合键合等技术协同。

summary_i18n.en: Samsung Electronics has filed a new patent to address delamination, warpage, and yield degradation in high-stack HBM (HBM4E/HBM5, 16+ layers). The patent designs the top dummy die with a three-tier stepped curved structure and uses deep groove sawing to improve mechanical strength and heat dissipation while reducing sawing debris contamination. Previously, 12-layer HBM yield drops 10-20pp vs 8-layer, and above 16 layers yields can fall to 40-60%. This patent is seen as a key technology to boost Samsung's HBM market share and can synergize with hybrid bonding.

items.key_claim: LG电子凭借20多年自研SoC经验和与台积电的超长期合作，开始向外部提供ASIC设计服务，成为台积电生态的增量受益者。

key_claim_i18n.en: Leveraging over 20 years of in-house SoC experience and a long-term partnership with TSMC, LG Electronics has begun offering external ASIC design services, becoming an incremental beneficiary of the TSMC ecosystem.
key_claim_i18n.zh: LG电子凭借20多年自研SoC经验和与台积电的超长期合作，开始向外部提供ASIC设计服务，成为台积电生态的增量受益者。

items.risk: LG电子并非台积电VCA（价值链联盟）成员，在韩国只有ASICLAND是唯一VCA，可能限制其获取优先产能及客户信任。

risk_i18n.en: LG Electronics is not a TSMC VCA (Value Chain Alliance) member; in Korea only ASICLAND holds that status, which may limit its access to priority capacity and customer trust.

items.summary: LG电子利用自家6nm及以下工艺IP组合和与台积电超过20年的合作信源，正式启动以SoC中心为核心的ASIC设计服务，商业模式对标博通和Marvell。首个成果是一款在台积电6nm制程量产的家用机器人芯片，承接自韩国国内无晶圆厂客户订单，并由LG电子HS事业部回购用于自家产品。LG电子采用自雇工程师方式，相比传统设计公司大幅降低人力外协成本，同时借助与台积电的长年信任关系，有望为客户提供晶圆产能担保。三星代工成熟工艺收缩预计推动部分国内需求转向台积电，进一步利好LG电子设计服务业务。

summary_i18n.en: LG Electronics is formally launching its ASIC design service based on its own IP portfolio for processes at 6nm and below, with its SoC Center at the core, leveraging over 20 years of partnership with TSMC. Its first result is a robot vacuum cleaner chipset mass-produced on TSMC's 6nm process, from a domestic fabless order, then repurchased by LG's HS Business Division. By using in-house engineers, LG significantly reduces external labor costs compared to traditional design houses, and its long-standing trust with TSMC may help secure wafer allocation for customers. Samsung Foundry's shrinking legacy processes are expected to push some domestic demand toward TSMC, further benefiting LG's design service.

items.summary: 2359是无敌的，制裁个鬼？制裁了美国药研公司先得吐血。绝对不要低估中国在生物医药上正在形成巨大、不可替代的非对称性优势。毕竟药的成本都是临床。引用 @Ryan Leung 梁興盛, CFA 的观点：药明康德easy money，康方生物根本制裁不了，因为康方生物没有可靠的出口管制制裁点，美国要跟中国医药体系脱钩需要时间。

summary_i18n.en: 2359 is invincible—sanction what? Sanctioning would first make US pharma R&D companies bleed. Never underestimate China's huge, irreplaceable asymmetric advantage in biopharma. key_claim_i18n.en: MTK's v8t starts volume production earlier than v8i, Humufish/Triggerfish is the only 2nm project in v9, and v10 Icefish looks solid; the market may be underestimating MTK's TPU progress in 2nm and inference.

items.key_claim: 三星电子正式启动1.4nm代工工艺（SF1.4）的先期开发，目标2029年量产，已要求应用材料、泛林等设备商提前研发配套设备，并确认特斯拉下一代AI芯片订单采用2nm工艺，显示三星在先进制程上重回正轨。

key_claim_i18n.en: Samsung Electronics has formally commenced advance development of its 1.4nm foundry process (SF1.4), targeting mass production in 2029, and has asked Applied Materials, Lam Research, and other equipment makers to start advance development of supporting tools. Additionally, it has secured Tesla's next-gen AI chip order using the 2nm node, signaling a recovery in its advanced process roadmap.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 三星电子正式启动1.4nm代工工艺（SF1.4）的先期开发，目标2029年量产，已要求应用材料、泛林等设备商提前研发配套设备，并确认特斯拉下一代AI芯片订单采用2nm工艺，显示三星在先进制程上重回正轨。

items.risk: 1.4nm量产时间仍较台积电（2028年）和英特尔（2027年）落后，设备与良率挑战巨大；若2nm良率持续不稳或特斯拉订单执行不力，后续1.4nm投入可能再次延后。

risk_i18n.en: The 1.4nm timeline still trails TSMC (2028) and Intel (2027), with significant equipment and yield challenges. If 2nm yield remains unstable or Tesla order execution falters, further 1.4nm investment may be delayed.

items.summary: 三星电子重启1.4nm（SF1.4）先进制程开发，量产目标从2027年调整至2029年，已向应用材料（Applied Materials）、泛林（Lam Research）等设备商发送先期开发请求。该公司近期2nm工艺良率实现稳定，并赢得特斯拉下一代AI芯片代工订单，这为其推进更先进制程提供了支撑。同时，三星已要求设备商支持V12 NAND（2030年量产）的开发，高NA EUV光刻机已到位。Jukan认为，三星此举意在缩小与台积电（2028年目标）和英特尔（2027年目标）的竞争差距。

summary_i18n.en: Samsung Electronics has restarted development of its 1.4nm (SF1.4) advanced process, shifting the mass production target from 2027 to 2029, and has reached out to Applied Materials, Lam Research, and other equipment makers for early development. The company recently stabilized 2nm yields and won Tesla's next-gen AI chip foundry order, providing a foundation for further process advancement. Samsung has also requested equipment support for V12 NAND (targeting 2030 mass production), and high-NA EUV lithography has already arrived. Jukan views this as an effort to close the competitive gap with TSMC (2028 target) and Intel (2027 target).

key_claim_i18n.en: Customers actively proposed 3-5 year LTAs, indicating the memory supply shortage will not end soon, and suppliers are for the first time securing a contract structure that sustains high margins over an extended period.
key_claim_i18n.zh: 客户主动提出3-5年长期协议，表明存储供应短缺不会短期内结束，供应商首次获得能够长期维持高利润率的合同结构。

items.risk: 三星和美光的LTA同时包含价格上限和下限，可能限制极端涨价空间；Micron的预付款结构为可退还而非抵扣收入，约束效果不同。

risk_i18n.en: Samsung's and Micron's LTAs include both price ceilings and floors, potentially capping extreme price increases; Micron's advance payment is refundable rather than deducted from revenue, offering a different constraint.
risk_i18n.zh: 三星和美光的LTA同时包含价格上限和下限，可能限制极端涨价空间；Micron的预付款结构为可退还而非抵扣收入，约束效果不同。

items.summary: 在供应商商品级DRAM运营利润率已达80%、毛利率超90%的情况下，客户主动提出3-5年长期协议，覆盖至2028年及以后，表明供应短缺不会快速结束。所有五大存储厂商（三星、SK Hynix、美光、Kioxia、SanDisk）均在签署类似结构LTA，这是存储器历史上首次实现长期高利润率的合同模式。SK Hynix仅设价格下限无上限，而三星和美光同时设有价格上下限。预付款结构为约束性条件，防止合同后随意变动产量；美光的预付款假设为可退还而非抵扣收入。

summary_i18n.en: with suppliers' commodity DRAM operating margins already at 80% and gross margins above 90%, customers proactively proposed 3-5 year LTAs covering 2028 and beyond, indicating the supply shortage will not end soon. All five major memory suppliers (Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk) are signing structurally similar LTAs, marking the first time in memory history that suppliers secure a contract structure to sustain high margins over an extended period. SK Hynix's LTA has only a price floor with no ceiling, while Samsung and Micron include both price ceilings and floors. The advance payment structure is a binding condition preventing arbitrary volume changes post-contract; Micron's advance payment is presumed refundable rather than deducted from revenue.
summary_i18n.zh: 在供应商商品级DRAM运营利润率已达80%、毛利率超90%的情况下，客户主动提出3-5年长期协议，覆盖至2028年及以后，表明供应短缺不会快速结束。所有五大存储厂商（三星、SK Hynix、美光、Kioxia、SanDisk）均在签署类似结构LTA，这是存储器历史上首次实现长期高利润率的合同模式。SK Hynix仅设价格下限无上限，而三星和美光同时设有价格上下限。预付款结构为约束性条件，防止合同后随意变动产量；美光的预付款假设为可退还而非抵扣收入。

items.key_claim: POET 采用 fab-lite（轻晶圆厂）商业模型，专注于设计并授权其专利 Optical Interposer，不直接出售成品光模块，而是将光学引擎卖给 Foxconn、Luxshare 和 Lumilens 等系统集成商，间接服务全球前三大超大规模云厂商。其中与 Lumilens 的 5 年框架协议价值超过 5 亿美元，Lumilens 的首个客户被行业共识指向亚马逊 AWS 或微软/谷歌。 重点标的: $POET, $NVDA, $AMZN, $GOOG, $MSFT., $AAPL, $BABA, $BIDU, $META, $GOOG., $MSFT

key_claim_i18n.en: POET operates a fab-lite business model, focusing on designing and licensing its patented Optical Interposer. It does not sell finished pluggable transceivers directly to data centers but sells optical engines to system integrators such as Foxconn, Luxshare, and Lumilens, indirectly serving the world's top three hyperscalers. The 5-year framework agreement with Lumilens is valued at over $500 million, and industry consensus points to Amazon AWS, Microsoft, or Google as Lumilens' first customer. Key tickers: $POET, $NVDA, $AMZN, $GOOG, $MSFT., $AAPL, $BABA, $BIDU, $META, $GOOG., $MSFT
